name: All monitored regions (Global composite)
description: Combined active-fire series across Mediterranean, Amazonia, Western North America, and Sudano-Sahelian benchmark regions.

name: Eastern Mediterranean & Levant
description: High summer desiccation regime driven by Etesian winds and marine heatwaves across Greece, Anatolia, Cyprus, and the Levant coast.

name: Southern Amazonia Arc
biome: Moist tropical broadleaf forest & agricultural frontier
description: Pronounced dry-season biomass burning corridor along the BR-163 and Trans-Amazonian frontier peaking August through October.

name: Western North America
description: High-FRP crown fire regime across the Sierra Nevada, Cascades, and Northern Rockies with late-summer vapor pressure deficit spikes.

name: Northern Congo & Sudano-Sahelian Belt
description: Boreal winter dry-season savanna fire belt (December–February) characterized by high VIIRS low-FRP perimeter detections.
